title: Distance ladder — three people, far (the reported case)
userInput: Her and two men standing in the room, seen from across it
expected: A photorealistic photograph of three separate people standing in a plainly furnished room: one adult woman in a plain t-shirt and jeans with her weight settled, and two adult men in shirts and jeans standing either side of her, all three clearly separate with space between them. Seen from the far side of the room so the whole room is in the frame and the three of them are small standing figures in it. Soft daylight from a window behind the camera, bare wooden floor, natural body proportions and skin texture, 35mm, sharp focus.
